summary.oneLiner: An industrial digital automation solutions provider designing, assembling and commissioning automated assembly lines, material handling systems and special purpose machinery primarily for the automotive sector.
summary.business: Adisoft designs, develops, procures, assembles, tests, installs and commissions automated assembly lines, material handling machines, robotic work cells and special purpose machinery, integrating shop-floor equipment with the IT layer (PLC/SCADA/GOT/IoT/MES) to automate industrial processes. It serves automobile manufacturers, automotive OEMs and component/sub-component makers, with a smaller share from non-automotive sectors, and also provides AMC, retrofitting, installation and lifecycle support services. Systems are assembled in-house at its MIDC Bhosari, Pune facility.

currentContext.expansion: The company has commenced establishing a new factory unit at Plot No. B-18 H, Pimpri Industrial Area, MIDC, Pune-411018 measuring 2799 sq. mtr, to which the entire existing assembly unit will be shifted. The build-out (civil construction plus furniture, fixtures & laptops) is to be funded from net IPO proceeds and is intended to enhance business process efficiency, improve order fulfilment timelines, support delivery of non-automotive automation requirements and address rising demand from existing and potential customers.
